_comment: Data-driven cases for tests/checkout-country-state.spec.js (guest /checkout). Each key (except _comment) becomes its own Playwright test() — run one with -g "<Country>". Folds three GI tests: 'Validate Each Country's State Dropdowns' (the Country->State/Province swap), 'International Zipcode' (a valid in-country postal clears the error — Canada is the international case), and the happy-path half of 'Shipping Address & Zip Form Validation'. PRODUCTION only ships to US + Canada; UAT exposes more countries but we intentionally ignore them. Select option values are '<code>|<name>' exactly as the live <select> exposes them. expectStatePresent/expectStateAbsent assert the dropdown swap. validZip is that country's postal format and must clear the inline error.
